name: Stephanie Liu
current_role: Co-founder and Chief Technology Officer, Nourish (virtual dietitian / nutrition-care platform, New York)
profile: Stephanie Liu co-founded Nourish in 2021 with Aidan Dewar and Sam Perkins and leads its technology as CTO. Nourish connects patients with registered dietitians covered by insurance; it raised a $70M Series B (2025, reported >$1B valuation) and a $100M Series C led by Menlo Ventures in May 2026 at a reported $1.75B valuation.
interesting_fact: Nourish was reported to be profitable at the time of its 2025 Series B, a rarity for a fast-growing digital-health startup; the 2026 Series C brought total funding to about $215M.
deep_cut_fact: Liu met co-founder Sam Perkins while they were both studying at Princeton; Perkins then brought her together with his childhood friend Aidan Dewar to start Nourish.
notes: Low public profile; few interviews. Press contact (Britta Franson, PR for Nourish) appears on Business Wire releases 2024 and Feb 2026 (could not load the page directly; confirmed via search snippets). Company LinkedIn/site are company-level, not personal.

name: Vlad Slepnev
current_role: Co-founder, Curative (listed as Chief Scientific Officer / Chief Scientific Advisor; sources differ)
profile: Vladimir 'Vlad' Slepnev is a molecular biologist who co-founded Curative in January 2020 with Fred Turner and Isaac Turner, originally to build sepsis diagnostics. Curative pivoted to COVID-19 testing in March 2020, became one of the largest US testing providers, and later reinvented itself as a health insurer with no co-pays or deductibles.
interesting_fact: Curative started as a sepsis-diagnostics company and abruptly pivoted to COVID-19 testing in March 2020 amid national shortages of test kits and lab capacity, before winding testing down in 2022 to focus on health insurance.
deep_cut_fact: Long before Curative, Slepnev founded diagnostics company PrimeraDx in 2004 (serving as its CTO), and earlier was Director of Molecular Biology at Sention and a faculty member at Yale University.
notes: Very low public profile scientist-founder; Crunchbase says PrimeraDx raised $50M+ and was sold to Qiagen (single source, unverified). Best route is Curative media relations (press@curative.com). Also previously VP R&D at Shield Bio (Oct 2018-Jan 2020) per aggregator profiles.

name: Duran Akcaylier
current_role: Unknown; former co-founder of Airalo (left the company in 2020)
profile: Duran Akcaylier is a web application designer and developer who co-founded eSIM marketplace Airalo in 2019 with Ahmet Bahadir Ozdemir and Abraham Burak. He left the company in 2020; Airalo went on to reach 20M users and unicorn status after a $220M CVC-led round in July 2025. His current activity is not publicly documented.
interesting_fact: Airalo, which he co-founded, was selected for Sequoia Capital's second Surge cohort in 2019 and became a unicorn in 2025 after reaching 20 million users.
notes: Almost no public footprint under this spelling; departure in 2020 means he likely holds little or no current Airalo role (wealth figure may be overstated). Identity confirmed only as Airalo co-founder per Wikipedia. No published contacts found; Airalo press would not be a route to him.
